scope: Original-pair remote upgrades and read-only readiness on two Meizu Android 15 phones; silent screen-capture flow and private file return on one phone. This is not acceptance of all sensitive permissions or exact recording wall-clock duration.

Download-sheet semantic click rejected as stale; fresh visible normalized tap worked

instinct.upgrade_incident: First browser download stalled about 90 seconds; normal back/reopen/retry completed, then the ordinary installer updated the existing App.
capture_incidents: An earlier request lost task authorization while waiting for consent and was canceled without a recording.
An earlier completed recording contained the launcher because a rejected calculator launch was not resolved. It was retained as a failed task.
That earlier download disappeared with a temporary child workspace; the same phone file was downloaded again and retained as a private attachment.
Calculator taps initially reused an invalid observation identifier; the agent corrected this using each fresh response.
The single consent tap returned gesture_interrupted_outcome_unknown; the agent reconciled media-status rather than tapping again, and the capture finished.
instinct.consent: Owner explicitly approved this silent calculator recording; the normal system confirmation was clicked by an authorized delegate, not the owner personally.

interpretation: The actual returned frame shows 19×23=437 in the calculator; no audio stream was present.
The MP4 duration is not eight seconds: the last frame is at 7.534378 seconds and its 3.837644-second duration extends playback to 11.372 seconds.
This packet evidence does not establish the exact wall-clock moment when the recorder stopped; it is not evidence of capture before permission.
Permission readiness is not positive notification delivery, actual SIM PIN input, camera capture or microphone acceptance.
The three disconnect recoveries observed on phone A do not establish continuous availability; the underlying network cause is not isolated.
not_verified: Additional OEMs and independent new-user installation
privacy: Raw phone images, videos, file paths, pairing data and private chat content are not included.
